task: Replace the well-known APISIX Admin API key with a generated Secret consumed by APISIX and the ingress controller, with a verified rotation path

events.summary: Live Kakao APISIX ran the public upstream default admin key (owner approved the fix). Consumers: 08-1 (Secret + bootstrap values + IC helm adminKey), gitops apisix.yaml (already secretName), 13-2 portal bindings and show-credentials (read the Secret). No live cluster change in this PR.

Original 08-1 helpers accepted any non-placeholder value as a key, so the chart-rendered public default read back from configmap/apisix was persisted into the Secret. The new fake-kubectl check run against origin/main's lib.sh fails (no apisix_key_usable / resolve_apisix_keys; 'random key rejected'), and passes with the fix. Reproduced statically; the live cluster was not touched.

Root cause: bootstrap values set no admin credentials, the chart rendered its default into the configmap and 08-1 read it back into the Secret. Fix: resolve_apisix_keys generates keys, rejects upstream defaults by sha256 and placeholders, preserves existing random keys; APISIX uses admin.credentials.secretName, the controller existingSecret (both verified in the vendored chart 2.13.0 / 0.14.1 templates). rotate-apisix-admin-key.sh orders Secret, APISIX config, APISIX restart, controller, verification. lib.sh NotFound checks anchored. Review round 1: verification via port-forward + host curl (the APISIX image has no curl), rollback on failure, keys via files not argv, portal Secret re-synced, default-key check by sha256 over all tracked files.
